addClaims.text: While the app's publishing status is Testing, only up to 100 listed test users can authorize it.
addClaims.quote: Projects configured with a publishing status of Testing are limited to up to 100 test users listed in the OAuth consent screen.

addClaims.text: In Testing mode, a test user's authorization (including refresh tokens) expires seven days after consent, so an always-on agent loses access weekly.
addClaims.quote: Authorizations by a test user will expire seven days from the time of consent.

addClaims.text: Apps that access restricted Gmail data from or through a server must pass a security assessment from a Google-empanelled assessor.
addClaims.quote: must go through a security assessment from Google-empanelled security assessors

addClaims.text: Restricted scope verification can take several weeks.
addClaims.quote: the restricted scopes verification process can potentially take several weeks to complete

addClaims.text: Brand verification comes first and typically takes 2-3 business days.
addClaims.quote: step first, which typically takes 2-3 business days

addClaims.text: Depending on data sensitivity, Google says verification might take several months.
addClaims.quote: Depending on the sensitivity of the data being requested, verification might require several months for the app to complete.

addClaims.text: gmail.send lets the app send email on the user's behalf (listed as a sensitive scope).
addClaims.quote: auth/gmail.send | Send email on your behalf.

addClaims.text: gmail.readonly lets the app view email messages and settings (a restricted scope).
addClaims.quote: auth/gmail.readonly | View your email messages and settings.

addClaims.text: gmail.modify lets the app read, compose and send email (a restricted scope).
addClaims.quote: auth/gmail.modify | Read, compose, and send emails from your Gmail account.

addClaims.text: Full mailbox access (https://mail.google.com/) is a restricted scope that includes permanent deletion.
addClaims.quote: Read, compose, send, and permanently delete all your email from Gmail.

verdict.summary: Testing works in minutes (or instantly with Composio's managed app), but production with restricted scopes like gmail.readonly means brand verification, scope verification and a third-party security assessment: weeks, sometimes months.
verdict.cost: Free to register; restricted scopes add a paid third-party security assessment

replaceScopes.purpose: Send email on the user's behalf
replaceScopes.alternative: If you only send, request gmail.send alone: sensitive-scope verification, no security assessment
gmail.metadata (labels and headers only) if you don't need bodies
Split into gmail.send + gmail.readonly only where needed

replaceScopes.purpose: Full mailbox access including permanent delete

addRequirements.label: Annual third-party security assessment (restricted scopes on a server)
addRequirements.when: If you request restricted scopes such as gmail.readonly or gmail.modify and your server can access the data

addRequirements.label: 100 test users while in Testing
addRequirements.when: Until the app is published and verified

addBlockers.symptom: Agent's Gmail tool calls start failing with invalid_grant about a week after a user connected
addBlockers.cause: The OAuth app is still in Testing: test-user authorizations and refresh tokens expire seven days after consent.
addBlockers.fix: Publish the app to production (and complete verification for the scopes you use), then have users reconnect.
addBlockers.fallback: Use Composio's managed Gmail app until your own app is verified.

addBlockers.symptom: New users can't authorize: the app is limited to its test users
addBlockers.cause: Testing status allows at most 100 listed test users.
addBlockers.fix: Add the user as a test user (if under the cap) or publish and verify the app.
addBlockers.fallback: Composio's managed Gmail app while verification is pending.

addUncertainties: CASA assessment cost and assessor turnaround are set by the assessor, not Google; budget and time vary.
'invalid_grant' is the standard OAuth error for an expired refresh token; Google's page states the expiry but not the exact error string.
